data.text:
RECKONING CODE
THE PERPETUAL WAR
THE KOREA NARRATIVE

‘THE WAR 
THAT WASN’T 
DECLARED’

No paperwork ever came.
No declaration.
No vote.
No warning.

Bombs fell anyway.

Children woke to fire.
Fathers ran with rifles
left over from the last war.

They called it a conflict,
a police action,
a skirmish.

But cities burned.
Villages disappeared.
And three million people
stopped breathing.

The language
didn’t match the bodies.

This wasn’t war, they said.
Just stability enforcement.

And so,
without ever naming it,
they made it endless.

It had been done before. 
In Manila. 
In Athens. 
In Jakarta.

Refined here.

It would be done again. 
In Saigon. 
In Baghdad. 
In Kabul.

Justified.
Funded.
Forgotten.

data.text:
Nais linawin ng MMDA na maaari pa ring manghuli ang mga on-ground traffic enforcers ng ahensiya na naka-deploy sa mga pangunahing lansangan sa Metro Manila.

Kahit umiiral ang No Contact Apprehension Policy (NCAP) ng MMDA, tuloy pa rin ang physical apprehension dahil may mga blind spot areas na walang CCTV cameras. Kinakailangan pa rin itong tauhan ng enforcer upang tiketan ang mga lumalabag sa batas-trapiko.

Tinitiyak ng MMDA na hindi madodoble ang record ng traffic violations ng mga motorista.

Isinusumite ng mga traffic enforcers sa MMDA ang mga traffic violation tickets ng mga nahuli para mai-counter check kung nai-record din ito ng mga camera sa ilalim ng NCAP.
#mmda

data.text:
Teachers and staff of San Gabriel Elementary School in Macabebe, Pampanga, clean flood-affected school grounds on the second day of Brigada Eskwela on Tuesday, June 10. 

The school has been plagued by decades of flooding due to rising water levels and climate change, making it increasingly difficult for students and teachers to hold classes—especially during typhoon season. 

President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has ordered the rehabilitation of old and dilapidated classrooms, aiming to transform schools into smart, climate-resilient learning facilities. The initiative also seeks to digitally empower teachers and enhance the overall teaching and learning environment for Filipino students. 

📷: Santi San Juan | MB

data.text:
Nakiisa ang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) sa pangunguna ni MMDA Deputy Chairman Usec. Frisco San Juan Jr. sa Pampamahalaang Programa at Serbisyo na sinimulan sa pamamagitan ng isang ribbon cutting ceremony sa Quirino Grandstand, Manila City para sa pagdiriwang ng Araw ng Kalayaan.

Iba't ibang serbisyo ang alok ng mga ahensiya ng pamahalaan para sa publiko, kasama ang MMDA na nagtayo ng booth na itinatampok ang pitong mandato ng ahensiya; Flood Control and Sewerage Management, Urban Renewal, Zoning and Land Use Planning and Shelter Services, Health and Sanitation, Urban Protection and Pollution Control, Public Safety, Development Planning, Solid Waste Disposal and Management, at Transport and Traffic Management.

Layunin ng mga booths na ito na ilapit sa publiko ang mga serbisyong pang-kalinisan, kalikasan, edukasyon, turismo, negosyo, trabaho, pang-kabuhayan, at marami pang iba.

Mayroon din mga booths na ipinakikita ang tungkol sa kasaysayan, sining at kultura upang kilalanin at ipaalala ang mga sakripisyo na nagbigay-daan sa ating kasarinlan.

#mmda #mmdaatyourservice
